query:
SELECT DISTINCT ac.id, ac.name, ac.email, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE client_id = ac.id) as total_subscriptions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription_charges sc 
   INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscription_id = s.id 
   WHERE s.client_id = ac.id) as total_charges
FROM allowed_clients ac
WHERE ac.is_active = 1
ORDER BY ac.name;
